newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola Bottling to buy 508,426 shares.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola Bottling to buy 508,426 shares.

text.p: Coca-Cola Bottling Co Consolidated said on Monday based on a preliminary count for its Dutch auction self-tender offer, it expected to buy about 508,426 shares of its common stock from shareholders at a price of $46 per share.
This amounted to about 6.4 percent of all shares of common outstanding stock before the tender offer began, the company said. The tender offer expired on December 13, it said.

Under terms of the deal, which began November 14, Coca-Cola Bottling said it offered to buy for cash up to 500,000 shares of common stock at a purchase price not greater than $47.50 or less then $42.50 per share. It was permitted to increase the number of shares bought under terms of the deal, Coca-Cola Bottling said.
